_meta.notes: BUNDLE: 5-page PDF = page 1 'Dissolution of a Candidate Campaign Committee' notice (committee 'Jeff Hatch for County Council District 4', established 3-9-12, signed 12-24-12), page 2 the Financial Disclosure Report cover, page 3 the Summary Page, pages 4-5 the itemized schedules. Cover and Summary transcribed from pages 2-3. This is the SAME filed report as key 798c1620 (Hatch_Jeff_12_Council4_Final_Redacted.pdf) with the dissolution notice stapled in front - the figures are identical. Same handwriting caution as that filing: the joined double-zero in Line 1 Col B and Line 2 could be misread as an extra digit; Lines 4/5/6 read 2007.05 cleanly. On page 2 the address block is NOT redacted in this copy.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: p4 rows 2007.05 = printed subtotal 2007.05 (and the same figure in TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED). p5 rows 2007.05 = printed subtotal 2007.05 (and the same in TOTAL EXPENDITURES MADE). BOTH GATES EXACT on the first read. The p4 gate is what fixes the bare '.11' Wells Fargo interest row as 0.11 rather than 11.00 - the page will not close on any other reading.
itemized.notes: Handwritten form, Jeffrey Hatch, Final/Dissolution, form's own Date of Report 12-24-12, clerk RECEIVED stamp DEC 28 2012. PAGE ORDER: the PDF's page 3 is the form's Summary Page ('Page 1 of 3'), page 4 the contributions schedule ('Page 2 of 3') and page 5 the expenditures schedule ('Page 3 of 3'). Contributions and expenditures are IDENTICAL at 2007.05 and the Summary Page closes at a zero balance both ends - consistent with a dissolution filing that spent out exactly. the Complete Mailing Address column IS filled on this filing and is NOT redacted; the street line and ZIP were discarded at read time per privacy and are written nowhere - only the printed city and state are kept. THIS IS ONE OF ONLY TWO FILINGS IN THE CHUNK WITH AN UNREDACTED ADDRESS COLUMN, so it is the only place donor geography could be captured at all; four donors are out of state (Boulder CO, Mill Valley CA x2, San Mateo CA). Two rows are not ordinary donations and are transcribed as the filer wrote them: a Wells Fargo Bank line whose occupation cell reads 'interest on account' (0.11) and a line from the candidate himself whose occupation cell reads 'loan to campaign' (806.94). FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: 11 dates / 11 names / 11 addresses / 11 amounts on p4 and 11/11/11/11 on p5, each in its own ruled column; the occupation cells track their contributors; both pages gate exactly. No shift found.
